title: Beyond Single-Turn: A Survey on Multi-Turn Interactions with Large Language Models
measurement_description: The paper surveys existing research and describes the 'FairMT-Bench' benchmark, which evaluates fairness in multi-turn dialogues. This evaluation includes measuring bias, specifically stereotypes and toxicity, related to religion as one of six sensitive attributes.
findings: The paper reports findings from Fan et al. (2025) that LLMs can accumulate and amplify biases, including those related to religion, more readily in multi-turn conversational settings compared to single-turn prompts. The 'FairMT-Bench' benchmark revealed significant variation in fairness performance across different state-of-the-art models when engaged in discussions involving sensitive attributes like religion.
